idea_summary: AI powered terminal and Git hook code review and refactoring tool
market_summary: Terminal-based Git tools and AI code review repositories have experienced rapid growth. However, CLI tools featuring local LLM fallback and sub-second Groq inference are not yet saturated.
unmet_needs: Instant feedback on large git diffs with ultra-low latency
Offline local LLM (Ollama / Llama.cpp) fallback support when offline
Rich interactive terminal visual diff highlighting
differentiators: Sub-second response latency leveraging Groq Llama 3 inference
Extensible open-source rules engine with local configuration support
actionable_recommendations: 1. Build a fast terminal MVP using Typer and Rich.
2. Implement a hybrid Groq and Ollama provider architecture from day one.
3. Enable single-command `.pre-commit-config.yaml` setup for developer repos.
